name: A-477
description: A-477 was a security droid that worked for the casino cruiser Morenia in 3 ABY. That year, A-477 dispatched a report to the ship's database which detailed the cheating habits of a Quarren gambler named Ultus. The report noted that Ultus was a habitual cheater who played with his chips to distract other players when he was palming a card with his other hand.
